display_name: LoRa W24 中心窗配平的有色源扰动（Full）
description: Compare low-pass-shaped and white source noise at the same per-packet W24 center injected noise power.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Fixed original E104, matched lawful source L_s true CE and clean U_s high-confidence pseudo CE, source-only independent generic perturbations. No input from U_s true TX, target, source V, registered practical, or any true simulation trace during fitting.

checkpoint.initialization: Both arms load the same pre-target source-selected strong-source parent from 40000 cumulative source steps, and the original frozen E104. Reset AdamW.

sources.role: New G common source freeze and archival Full comparator.
Frozen first recovery and formal Full historical comparator.
Original E104 PAMF and fixed clean anchor; remains fixed in G-only CE row.
Fixed-step original loss U-Net common initialization.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Parent stronger-source model passed fixed source conditions before target. Training receives no target, target metrics, V truth, U TX, or practical channel trace.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze both at +10000. Only colored_source may promote. Same 300 Full source V packets. Six strictly above the white matched arm and all compared frozen baselines, low urban strictly above matched white and at least the strong-source parent and other baselines, clean at least direct and strong-source parent.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 preferred 0,3,7,2,6,5 when >=12 GiB free and fewer than eight existing GPU contexts. Two fit workers, up to three formal workers, at most one run-owned per card.
execution.stop_rule: Stop later phases on illegal data, failed real no-query smoke, nonfinite fit, broken source match, incompatible frozen parent, or invalid target shard. Preserve raw logs and checkpoints. No formal if fixed source rule misses.

metric_names: sampled waveform and clean training losses
strong source branch actual sampled exposures and nominal SNR range
post-resample center noise RMS matching and measured spectral shape change
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source score then conditional local w24_joint_pamf collect after all Full shards are frozen.

rows.method: Fixed E104 continuation with matched reference white strong synthetic noise, and remaining old generic observations.
rows.seed_notes: Shared data and original generic seed 2026112999, common Bernoulli and white-noise seed 2026113000, color cutoff seed 2026113001 independent. Source V panel 2026112559 after freeze.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, G lr 4e-5 cosine to 2e-6, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 10000 additional steps, 160000 L_s and 160000 U_s exposures; 50000 cumulative recovery steps.

rows.method: Fixed E104 continuation with center-power matched low-pass shaped strong synthetic noise, and remaining old generic observations.
rows.seed_notes: Shared data and original generic seed 2026112999, common Bernoulli and white-noise seed 2026113000, color cutoff seed 2026113001 independent. Source V panel 2026112559 after freeze.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, G lr 4e-5 cosine to 2e-6, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 10000 additional steps, 160000 L_s and 160000 U_s exposures; 50000 cumulative recovery steps.

notes: Both arms share the same packet order, old generic draws, Bernoulli mask, nominal capture-rate white-reference SNR (−8 to +4 dB), and underlying white noise. In the candidate only, frequency response [1+(f/fc)^4]^(-1/2), fc randomly 75–200 kHz, shapes the raw noise. Absolute noise power at capture rate need not match. Before adding noise, match each colored draw to the corresponding white RMS through the actual W24 384-center resampler across eight chirps. Native edges remain actual received samples.

Both training arms keep fixed E104 clean U_s pseudo labels at threshold .95 and L_s true CE. No hidden U_s label. W24 inputs, original head, half writeback and deployed inference are unchanged. Noise spectra and SNR are source-only simulated training quantities.

Parent was selected before formal test. Full predictions freeze before independent official labels; parent archived predictions appended as comparison. Parent scores and target truth do not affect this run.
